conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service Investigations, this is Officer Miller. Who am I speaking with?
Um, hello, my name is Rajeev Patel. I got a call about some tax issue? I'm not really sure what this is about.
Yes, Mr. Patel, I see your file. This concerns serious discrepancies in your federal tax filings over the past three years. Are you aware of any mistakes in your tax returns?
No, I used a company to help me with my taxes. I thought everything was correct.
Well, according to our audit, there are significant underreported earnings and missed payments. This is a violation of IRS regulations. Do you understand the seriousness of this?
No, I really don't... I'm new to the U.S., I just follow what my accountant told me.

Unfortunately, ignorance of the law is not a defense. There is now a legal warrant issued in your name for tax evasion and fraud. If not handled immediately, you can be detained, and your work permit may be suspended.
A warrant? I... I didn't know. Please, this is very frightening. What can I do?
You are currently facing arrest and possible deportation. However, the IRS allows a one-time resolution payment to cancel the warrant before your case is escalated to local authorities.
I don't want to be arrested. Please, I can pay if I need to, but I don't know how this works.
Listen carefully. You must settle the outstanding balance of $3,700 immediately. Failure to do so will result in your name being forwarded to the police. Do you have access to that amount right now?
I think so, maybe with my savings and credit card. How do I pay?
For your case, payment must be made through government-approved channels. We accept payment through Bitcoin or prepaid gift cards due to auditing procedures. Do you understand?
Bitcoin? I've never used that before. Is there another way?

These are the only approved methods. If you cannot use Bitcoin, you must purchase Target or Apple gift cards totaling $3,700. Do not discuss this payment with store employees, as it is a confidential federal process.
Okay, I can try to do that. Where do I send the gift card information?
Once you purchase the cards, stay on the line and read me the codes from the back. Do this immediately, or the system will automatically proceed with your arrest.
Can I go to the store now and call you back?
No, you must remain on the line at all times. If the call disconnects, it will be considered non-compliance, and your case will be handed to law enforcement.
Alright, I will go now. Please, you won't arrest me if I do this, right?
As long as you follow my instructions exactly, your warrant will be canceled. Do not attempt to call anyone or hang up, or the IRS will have no choice but to proceed.
I am leaving for the store now. This is very stressful.
Keep your phone on speaker. Once you have the cards, tell me the type and denomination, then read the numbers clearly.
Okay, I'm walking now. Should I get all Target cards?
Yes, Target or Apple cards are acceptable. Make sure the total is $3,700. Do not let anyone question you about the purchase.
Alright. I have to use my credit card to buy them, is that okay?
That is fine. The IRS does not monitor the payment method you use for purchasing the gift cards, only that the codes are provided now.
I'm at the store now. I need a moment to buy the cards.
Good. Do not hang up. Remember, if you fail to provide the codes in the next 15 minutes, your file will be locked and law enforcement will be notified at your home and workplace.
